[SWS_DM_00356] Requesting Notification of a channel reestablishment
⌈
The DM shall call the NotifyReestablishment (see [SWS_DM_00326]) method of
a Uds Transport Protocol implementation, with the parameter channel_id set
to the identifier of the Channel, where it needs a re-establishment notification.
⌋

[SWS_DM_00356] Requesting Notification of a channel reestablishment
⌈

Handler::NotifyReestablishment method of a UDS Transport Protocol
implementation, with the parameter channelId set to the identifier of the Channel,
where it needs a re-establishment notification.
